rules: Never use seawater, frame or shield for normal DC return.

SD-50 FG pin3 terminates to a reviewed frame/equipotential bond, not blindly to DC negative. Conductive accessible parts require specialist touch/fault assessment; plastic enclosure is not a grounding solution by itself.
Separate input and output negative until whole-system bond/isolation review; USB, Ethernet, antenna and sensor shields can bridge converter isolation.
Above-water local ESP and RAK grounds share the intended logic reference only after power topology review; power-off UART backfeed remains a gate.

Route hydrophone low-level analog/shield away from DC/DC inductors, PV switching, radio and any later output path. Shield single-ended/both-ended/chassis termination depends on sensor/DAQ and measured noise, not a universal rule.
Use galvanically isolated conditioned interfaces for wet probes where required by reviewed design. No direct wet I2C,12V,5V logic or unconditioned battery divider into ESP pins.

Lightning/surge protection, shore protective earth, equipotential bonding, corrosion couples and vessel/farm earth arrangements require a site-specific specialist review. No claimed marine isolation or electrical certification.

optional_output_safety.status: CONCEPT ONLY; absent by default; no selected safety hardware or authorization
optional_output_safety.physical_stop_contact_type: two independent NC channels proposed; final safety architecture review required
optional_output_safety.manual_rearm: local monitored NO momentary button; release must be seen healthy before a new press; no tied-down or remote reset; power return/stop release/watchdog recovery never rearms
optional_output_safety.physical_key: local key permission required in series with safety logic; key alone cannot rearm
optional_output_safety.watchdog: independent hardware window/edge watchdog with independent failure assessment; healthy signal deasserts on missing/too-fast/static heartbeat, power loss or watchdog fault; no Pi/ESP internal watchdog substitute
optional_output_safety.coil_control: independent selected safety controller owns K1/K2 coils; Pi/ESP/GPIO only may veto/request, never supply coil or bypass latch
optional_output_safety.feedback: monitor K1/K2 mechanically linked/force-guided auxiliary state as appropriate; reject welded contact/rearm discrepancy; exact COTS device and monitoring timing unresolved
optional_output_safety.energy_path: F-OUT and lockable service isolator precede dual series NO disconnects. For floating two-wire supply, review dual-pole interruption of both conductors. Amplifier enable also defaults low but is not primary protection. Signal/power grounds, USB/audio inputs and spare feeds must not bypass isolation.
optional_output_safety.stored_energy: downstream amplifier/filter/cable energy and discharge/dump path require sizing and measured time-to-safe; opening supply alone does not prove immediate acoustic silence
optional_output_safety.separate_keep_alive: passive monitoring/diagnostics remain on separate fused path if electrically safe
